quest.title: Adventurers in Windblume
quest.description: Iris, who has set up shop at the Dragonspine base camp, seems to want some help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about your commission...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Saw my commission and came running, did you? Well, I do have something that I need your help with.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Specifically, I'd like you to take pictures of two places on Dragonspine. I'll mark the exact locations for you on your map.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: As for compensation, I'll make sure you're paid as per the Adventurers' Guild's rules.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: How about it? Will you take the commission?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you need to take pictures in these two spots?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Well... this has to do with Cyrus, ultimately.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: He asked me previously to get him some of Dragonspine's specialties. Said he wanted to use them as part of a recruitment drive during the Windblume Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Well, now's the festival period, but he hasn't contacted me at all. Must be busy, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Now that I mention it, he is at that age, isn't he? He should be busy with the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think he might be way too old for that by now...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Really? I don't really get that feeling. In fact... Hmm, never mind. Let's not get into that right now.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: So far, I've collected some ores and put together some topographical charts and monster reports. I'd like some photos of scenic spots in Dragonspine to go with them.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: So, Traveler, would you mind helping me go up Dragonspine to take pictures of those two spots?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can count on me.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Great, I'll leave it in your hands, then. I've marked the two places out on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going to the city to see how things are going?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: It's all a little too much for me. I personally prefer how things are here.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I've got quite a lot on my plate to boot, so I doubt I can go at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I've marked the most scenic spots on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.

talks.objective: Head over to the designated area and take a picture

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {M#amigo}{F#amiga}! Would you like to hear my latest composition?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Adventurers' Guild recruitment...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Adventurers' Guild recruitment? Lo siento, I'm not interested in such things. Running around like a headless chicken is of no use to a bard.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Besides, in the city of Mondstadt, surely the Knights of Favonius constitute better source material for composing an epic...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Lo siento, I'm not interested in the Adventurers' Guild recruitment. Rescuing cats... isn't great song-writing material.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the recruitment material.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Is this... Dragonspine? Qué vista magnífica...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Perhaps a spot of sight-seeing would give me new flourishes of inspiration. And it doesn't look too dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'll pass by the Guild later and have a word. Even if I don't sign up, I'm sure I could hire an adventurer to escort me...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.

talks.objective: Head over to the designated area and take a picture

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Oh! Can I help you? I was just about to start a tune.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Adventurers' Guild recruitment...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Oh, that... I did see a notice, but it doesn't interest me. I can protect Mondstadt with my song, I don't need to become an adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: I heard that the majority of commissions are odd jobs. I don't see how it would benefit me.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Sorry, I will politely decline, but thank you for thinking of me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's the recruitment material.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: Huh? That looks like Dragonspine. A Statue of The Seven surrounded by snow... such a striking image.

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: So this must be at quite an altitude? People say that you can see for miles around up there... I bet my voice could carry over much further distances...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: I'll go and ask at the Guild a little later. I'm sure I saw something about adventurers for hire...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: I had no idea that adventurers went to such places... fascinating.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about your commission...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Oh, you're done already?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure am.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Thanks for your hard work. I've got the package I intended to send to that boy ready as well. Would you mind delivering it to him? I'll have your payment ready once you're done, so do remember to come back here.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if this will be enough for him to use, but if he's recruiting, monster records and ores should pack the biggest punch...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* This recruitment drive doesn't look like it'll be any good at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Special delivery from Iris...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oh, she sent me something? Right, that's right. I did ask her before, but I wound up forgetting...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to enjoying the Windblume Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: The Windblume Festival? No, I haven't any time for that. Our previous recruitment program is obsolete, I'm busy coming up with a new one...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Let me see what Iris sent me...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ores... No, that's no use... Young people these days couldn't be bothered with this stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Maps? *sigh* Oh, it'll be useful to the Guild members, alright, but I don't think that it's any good for recruitment...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Notes concerning monsters? Well, we should make some extra copies for our adventurers, but forget using it to attract new people...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Oho, what's this? These two photos are pretty good. Beautiful scenery — and it looks safe, too. Ah, this'll catch someone's eye, that's for sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why're you picking this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like he's thrown out the ones actually related to adventuring...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Ah, you don't understand the state the Guild's in. Nowadays, young people aren't interested in things like monsters, ores and topographical maps anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If you want to get the modern youngster's attention, you need to give them something they can use.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: It's the Windblume Festival now, see, and these young folks are definitely spoiling for all sorts of unique — but not necessarily dangerous — ways of displaying their charm...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Adventuring in Dragonspine is one such thing they can do. If the photos interest them, they might come to the Guild to ask about them, and then, they might join the Guild...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And... even if they don't join, well... some extra commissions would be nice.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What's more, if you look at these two drawings, they are both positioned next to the main road. As long as you're careful, you shouldn't be in any danger...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're really scraping the bottom of the barrel, aren't we...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Well, this is how things are. I wouldn't do this if we had any other ideas we could use.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If you don't believe me, why don't you take these two photos and show them to some people?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: First, tell them that we're recruiting, and then show these two photos as "recruitment material."

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You'll see why I had to come up with this idea in no time at all.

talks.objective: Head to the Anemo Archon statue

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: A tour of Dragonspine... I can hardly wait.

talks.objective: Speak to the citizens around the Anemo Archon statue
Speak to the citizens around the Anemo Archon statue

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: How did it go? Did you manage to gauge how everyone feels?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I did.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Then you see what I mean... That's the way things are. I've gotten used to it by now.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't care how we do it... But so long as we find a method that brings results, I'll thank the Archons.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I guess you'll be heading back to Dragonspine soon to report in with Iris?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Do me a favor and deliver this letter to her. She'll definitely want to know about the situation of late here at the Guild. Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* I hope we get some new recruits this time... But will the type of person who responds to this kind of marketing tactic be reliable adventurer material...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the commission...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You're back! What took you so long? I bet Cyrus got you to run some extra errands...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I helped him make a few inquiries...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Just what is that boy up to now... Oh? A letter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This letter talks about the recent state of the Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Huh, doesn't feel like a short read. Seems like he has been busy after all, even during the Windblume Festival...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Still, if he is working so hard, it's about time the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild recruited some new members.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Once we have enough recruits, he should be able to delegate the smaller matters to others and come adventuring with me again... *sigh* That would be nice.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I'll give this a good read. But seeing as Cyrus added to your workload, it's only fair that I factor in some extra payment.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Here you go. Thanks for your hard work!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the commission...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I've marked the most scenic spots on your map. Just head there and come back once you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Take these two pictures and ask some people nearby. Then you'll see why I had to come up with this idea in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Helen
dialogues.text: I must go and ask at the Adventurers' Guild later...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: *sigh* I hope we get some new recruits this time... But will the type of person who responds to this kind of marketing tactic be reliable adventurer material...?
